Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
February 25, 2014
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Loretta Gerken, President of Vista Golden K Kiwanis Club
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Law Enforcement Awards
P2.
Adopt-a-Block Recognition
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Approval of Public Arts Commission "Kites Over Vista" (CC)
C4.
Amendment to Chapter 1.12 of the Vista Municipal Code Concerning Code Enforcement (CC)
C5.
Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control Grant (CC)
C6.
Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule (ROPS 14-15A) (SA)
1.
Resolution No. 2014- , approving ROPS 14-15A;
2.
Resolution No. 2014- , approving the Administrative Budget;
3.
Resolution No. 2014- , approving repayments to the Low and Moderate Income Housing Fund; and
4.
Resolution No. 2014- , directing payment of amounts due on Item 58 of an approved ROPS from an alternative source of funds.
C7.
Downtown Specific Plan Update Agreement (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , approving an agreement for planning consulting services with CityPlace Planning, Inc.; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , amending the FY 2013/14 Operating Budget.
C8.
CIP No. 8232 Paseo Santa Fe Streetscape Improvements - Sewer, Water and Storm Drain Project Award of Contracts (CC)
1.
Resolution No. 2014- , awarding a construction contract to PK Mechanical Systems, Inc.;
2.
Resolution No. 2014- , approving the agreement with Vista Irrigation District (VID) for construction of water facilities; and
3.
Resolution No. 2014- , amending the Capital Improvement Program Budget for FY 2013/14.
C9.
Buena Vista Creek Improvements Project Design Award (CC)
C10.
CIP No. 8175 Age and Condition Related Sewer Rehabilitation Award of Contract (BSD)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Potential Skate Park Locations (CC)
D2.
Central Vista Business Improvement District (CVBID) Advisory Board Recommendation (CC)
D3.
Central Vista Business Improvement District (CVBID) Notice of Intent to Levy (CC)
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Appeal of Special Use Permit for 7-Eleven at 902 S. Santa Fe Avenue (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive testimony regarding an appeal for a Special Use Permit; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , denying a Special Use Permit to sell beer and wine for off-site consumption.
PH2.
2012 Regional Transportation Improvement Program (RTIP) Amendment (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive public comment on a list of transportation projects eligible to use transportation sales tax (TransNet) funds; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , adopting the TransNet Local Street Improvement Program of Projects for FY 2013 through 2018.
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
